w10_P4_001150: A pump works is setting up an index drive on the bench. Two timing wheels carry 142 teeth and 256 teeth, and the fitter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. The test slider is then run at a speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to that number, and the slider has a mass of 16000 g. The energy the slider carries by virtue of its motion is multiplied by the 8 sliders on the bench, and the bench total is expressed in kilojoules. A charged capacitor bank contributes a further 5 kJ to that bench total. The works operates 5 identical benches. What total figure, in kJ, does the works hold?
w10_P4_001152: A packaging machine's pusher travels along a guide, and its distance travelled is, in metres, 4*t^3 + 0*t^2 with t in seconds. The engineers read the pusher's speed at the instant t = 1 s, and the gearing means the carriage itself moves at 6 times that speed. The carriage has a mass of 14000 g. From the energy the carriage carries by virtue of its motion, 21 J is deducted for the guide friction. Each machine has 7 identical carriages, and the plant runs 12 identical machines. What total energy, in J, does the plant hold at that instant?
w10_P4_001153: A ski-lift workshop is measuring a test carrier on a straight rail. The carrier's speed v, in m/s, is the larger value that satisfies v^2 - 5v + 6 = 0. The carrier has a mass of 47 kg, and the workshop is kept at 16 degrees C. The energy the carrier carries by virtue of its motion is expressed in kilojoules, and the rail runs 10 identical carriers. A standing rig overhead of 27 kJ is subtracted from their combined figure, and a charged buffer then adds 17 kJ. What is the workshop's final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001156: A crane hire firm is rating a new lifting beam. The beam has 6 possible sling points, and the controller sets the carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, numerically equal to the number of distinct sets of 4 sling points that could be used together. The carriage has a mass of 61 kg, and the yard is at 14 degrees C. The hoist supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, and the rating sheet expresses it in kilonewtons. Each beam carries 6 identical carriages, and a standing hook allowance of 5 kN is added to a beam's combined figure. The firm owns 9 identical beams. What total figure, in kN, does the firm's fleet of beams show?
w10_P4_001157: A vehicle proving ground is commissioning a sled drive. The sled's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying a^2 - 5a + 6 = 0. The sled has a mass of 43 kg, and the control room is at 18 degrees C. The drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, and the commissioning sheet expresses that force in kilonewtons. Each track runs 2 identical sleds, and the ground has 10 identical tracks. What total force, in kN, do the ground's sled drives supply?
w10_P4_001160: A laboratory needs the final entry, in kilojoules, for a spring-launcher trial. The launcher's raw index is the area under the curve 2*x^2 + 7*x between x = 1 and x = 2, where x is the cam setting. The calibration then subtracts 20 from that raw index and adds a further 13 to what remains, and the result is the projectile's launch speed in metres per second. The projectile has a mass of 4 kg, and the bench sits at 21 degrees C. The entry records the energy the projectile carries by virtue of that motion. What is the final entry, in kJ?
w10_P4_001162: A bench technician needs the final figure, in kilonewtons, for a vibration fixture. Two index rings carry 24 holes and 49 holes, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. The fixture's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is set numerically equal to that number; the moving table has a mass of 13 kg, and the room sits at 22 degrees C. The shaker supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, and a pre-load spring adds a further 15 N. The result is expressed in kilonewtons, each rack holds 6 identical fixtures, and the laboratory has 8 identical racks. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001164: A rail-freight yard is rating a shunting ram. The ram's base rate b, in m/s^2, is the larger value satisfying b^2 - 9*b + 8 = 0. A control offset then adds 28 and a trim offset adds a further 9, giving the carriage's actual rate of change of speed in m/s^2. The carriage has a mass of 24000 g, and the yard hut is at 13 degrees C. The ram supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, and the yard runs 8 identical rams. A standing frame relief of 14 N is then taken off their combined force. What total force, in N, do the yard's rams apply?
w10_P4_001166: A propulsion laboratory needs the final entry, in kilojoules, for one test firing. The trolley's release speed, in metres per second, is the area under the curve 4*x^2 + 8*x between x = 0 and x = 1, where x is the throttle fraction. The trolley has a mass of 41 kg, and the test cell sits at 27 degrees C. The energy the trolley carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. A standing rig overhead of 28 kJ is subtracted from it, and a charged accumulator then adds 11 kJ. What is the final entry, in kJ?
w10_P4_001170: A mining contractor needs the total thrust, in kilonewtons, from a complete drill installation. The drill carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the area under the curve 5*x^2 + 2*x between x = 1 and x = 2, where x is the feed-lever index. The carriage has a mass of 85 kg, and each drill supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, recorded in kilonewtons. A boom carries 5 identical drills, a rig carries 8 booms, and the installation has 3 identical rigs. What total thrust, in kN, does the installation deliver?
w10_P4_001173: A steel plant needs the total force, in newtons, applied across its whole descaling section. Each header's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the sum of the whole numbers from 1 up to 12, one for each of its numbered pressure steps. The moving header has a mass of 177000 g, and each unit supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A frame carries 3 identical units, a stand carries 2 frames, a line carries 8 stands, and the plant runs 12 identical lines. What total force, in N, does the descaling section apply?
w10_P4_001176: A machine shop needs the net figure, in kilojoules, at the foot of its index sheet. Two dividing plates carry 198 holes and 166 holes, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. The test slider is then run at a speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to that number, and the slider has a mass of 41000 g. The energy the slider carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. A bearing allowance of 2 kJ and a standing instrument allowance of 27 kJ are then subtracted from it in turn. What is the net figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001178: A cycle-track laboratory needs the net figure, in kilojoules, for a coasting trial. The trolley's coasting speed v, in m/s, is the smaller value that satisfies v^2 - 7v + 12 = 0. The trolley has a mass of 52000 g, and the energy it carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules. A standing rig overhead of 27 kJ is subtracted from that figure. A further instrument allowance of 16 kJ is then subtracted as well. What is the net figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001182: A bottling plant is setting up a new index drive. Two star wheels carry 43 slots and 48 slots, and the fitter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. The gearbox then drives the carriage at 2 times that number, in m/s^2, and the carriage has a mass of 68 kg. The drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A guide spring adds 2 N, a cam follower adds a further 18 N, and a return spring adds another 23 N to the drive's load. What total load, in N, does the drive carry?
w10_P4_001188: A test hall has 8 anchor sockets set into its floor, and any two of them may be joined by a tie bar. The controller sets the trolley's speed, in metres per second, numerically equal to the number of distinct pairs of sockets that could be tied together. The trolley has a mass of 13 kg, and the hall is kept at 20 degrees C. From the energy the trolley carries by virtue of its motion, 26 J is deducted for the rail friction. The hall performs 9 identical runs and expresses their total in kilojoules. The operator runs the same programme in 2 identical halls. What total energy, in kJ, do the halls record?
w10_P4_001189: A tool maker is trialling a spring-loaded ejector. The ejector head has 6 possible port positions, and the trial starts from the number of distinct sets of 4 ports that could be opened together. From that number 10 is subtracted for the blocked patterns, and the result is the pellet's launch speed in metres per second. The pellet has a mass of 33000 g, and the bench sits at 17 degrees C. To the energy the pellet carries by virtue of that motion, 21 J is added for the latch, and 10 J is then deducted for the guide. The maker fires 9 identical ejectors. What total energy, in J, do the ejectors deliver?
w10_P4_001194: A textile machine's beam drive is being rated. The drive builds its rate of change of speed in 2 identical steps, and each step contributes 8 m/s^2 as the clutch takes up and a further 4 m/s^2 as it drives. The carriage has a mass of 46 kg, and the machine room is at 25 degrees C. The drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A brake shoe then relieves 23 N, a tension spring adds 11 N, a guide pad relieves 7 N, and a return spring adds a further 9 N. What total force, in N, does the drive carry?
w10_P4_001195: A physics teaching bench launches a trolley along a level rail. The launcher fires a numbered sequence of pushes in which push number k adds k m/s, with k running from 1 up to 4, so the trolley leaves at the accumulated speed. The trolley has a mass of 42 kg, and the bench sits at 21 degrees C. From the energy the trolley carries by virtue of its motion, 22 J is deducted for the rail friction. The bench performs 5 identical launches and expresses their total in kilojoules. A standing instrument allowance of 9 kJ is then subtracted. What is the bench's net figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001197: A greenhouse ventilation rig is being rated. The louvre carriage's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the larger value satisfying a^2 - 10a + 21 = 0. The carriage has a mass of 32 kg, and the glasshouse is held at 28 degrees C. The actuator supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A closing spring adds 12 N, a seal adds a further 8 N, and a counterbalance chain adds another 18 N to the actuator's load. What total load, in N, does the actuator carry?
w10_P4_001200: A conveyor manufacturer is rating a new tripper drive. The carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is the area under the curve 1*x^2 + 4*x between x = 0 and x = 1, where x is the ramp fraction. The carriage has a mass of 182000 g, and the drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion, recorded in kilonewtons. Each tripper carries 2 identical carriages, and a plant runs 2 identical trippers. A standing frame relief of 15 kN is then taken off the plant's combined figure. What is the plant's net figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001208: A glassworks is setting up a matched index pair. One wheel carries 279 teeth and the other carries 182 teeth, and the setter needs the largest whole number that divides both counts exactly. The pusher carriage's rate of change of speed, in m/s^2, is then set numerically equal to that number. The carriage has a mass of 95000 g, and the annealing hall is at 34 degrees C. Each drive supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion; a frame holds 4 identical drives, a lehr holds 4 frames, and the works has 3 identical lehrs. A standing relief of 19 N is then taken off the works' combined force. What total force, in N, does the works apply?
w10_P4_001209: A theatre is rating a new flying-bar winch. The bar's base rate b, in m/s^2, is the larger value satisfying b^2 - 7*b + 6 = 0, and the gearbox drives the carriage at 9 times that base rate. The carriage has a mass of 24 kg, and the fly tower sits at 19 degrees C. The winch supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A counterweight line adds 11 N to the winch's load, and a guide shoe then relieves 22 N. What total load, in N, does the winch carry?
w10_P4_001210: A funicular workshop is testing a loaded car on a straight test track. The car is brought up to speed by 3 identical drive stages, and each stage contributes 4 m/s while the clutch engages and a further 3 m/s while it drives. The car has a mass of 60000 g and runs at the accumulated speed. The energy it carries by virtue of that motion is expressed in kilojoules, and the workshop runs 7 identical cars. A standing rig overhead of 22 kJ is subtracted from their combined figure. The company operates 6 identical workshops. What is the company's total figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001213: A luge team is instrumenting a training sled. The push-off is delivered as a numbered sequence of strides in which stride number k adds k m/s, with k running from 1 up to 10, so the sled leaves at the accumulated speed. The sled has a mass of 28000 g, and the ice is held at 4 degrees C. From the energy the sled carries by virtue of its motion, 19 J is deducted for the runner friction and a further 5 J for the steering blocks. The team runs 2 identical sleds. What total energy, in J, do the sleds carry?
w10_P4_001216: A tunnel contractor needs the final figure, in kilonewtons, for a segment-erector installation. The erector's rate of change of speed a, in m/s^2, is the smaller value satisfying a^2 - 11a + 28 = 0. The moving arm has a mass of 142000 g, and each erector supplies exactly the force needed to produce that motion. A shield carries 12 identical erectors, and the contractor runs 11 identical shields. Their combined force is expressed in kilonewtons, and a standing rig allowance of 7 kN is then added. What is the final figure, in kN?
